label: The engine behind a store
description: What is asked of the engine itself rather than of the records. A startup step reaches ensure through a domain port bound to a data graph, so what a tree prepares is what its project.json says it prepares.

ensure.description: Make every collection the store declares ready to answer. It adds what is missing -- a collection that is not there, a column a shape has gained, a constraint the store declares -- and leaves alone everything that is. What that means is the engine's: nothing at all for one that keeps records in memory, where a collection exists as soon as it is asked for. It is additive everywhere and destructive nowhere: anything it would have to destroy or change is refused as drift, which is not a graph's outcome but a startup failure, so the step stops the tree the way an unreachable database does. Answers what it created, each zero on a second run and on an engine with nothing to create.

store.description: the path of the store document to prepare

columns.description: how many columns were created, in collections new and old
